updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (ISO 8601).

customsMRN.description: UK customs Movement Reference Number (MRN) of the goods: 18 characters, two digits for the year, `GB`, then 14 uppercase letters or digits. Only allowed for deliveries to a warehouse in the United Kingdom; you can set it while the delivery is `announced` or `atWarehouse`, including with a partial update after arrival. `null` when not provided.

description.description: Free-text summary of the contents of the delivery; `null` when not provided.

expectedDeliveryDateFrom.description: Start of the window in which the delivery is expected to arrive at the warehouse (ISO 8601, UTC). For `container` deliveries it must equal `expectedDeliveryDateTo`. Customers can only change it while the delivery is `announced`.

expectedDeliveryDateTo.description: End of the window in which the delivery is expected to arrive at the warehouse (ISO 8601, UTC). For `container` deliveries it must be a business day at least 10 business days from now. Customers can only change it while the delivery is `announced`.

expressInbounding.description: Whether express inbounding is requested. Always send `false`.

isInternational.description: Whether the goods cross a border into the warehouse's country. Only for deliveries to a warehouse in the United Kingdom, where it is required when announcing or fully updating the delivery. When `true`, `senderName` and `senderAddress` are required and the warehouse cannot inbound the delivery until `customsMRN` is provided. Customers can still declare it `true` with a partial update after the delivery has left `announced`, but not change it back once the goods have arrived. `null` when it does not apply.

referenceNumber.description: Your own reference for the delivery, such as a purchase order number; `null` when not provided.

requiresCounting.description: Whether the warehouse counts every item on arrival; charges may apply. When `false`, stock is booked as announced and byrd is not liable for discrepancies. Defaults to `true`; cannot be `true` together with `requiresSampling`. Customers can only change it while the delivery is `announced`.

requiresSampling.description: Whether the warehouse checks a representative sample of the goods on arrival instead of counting every item. Defaults to `false`; cannot be `true` together with `requiresCounting`. Customers can only change it while the delivery is `announced`.

senderAddress.description: Address the delivery is sent from; required for international deliveries, otherwise `null` when not provided. Part of the customs declaration, so customers can still change it with a partial update after the delivery has left `announced`.

senderName.description: Name of the sender of the delivery; required for international deliveries, otherwise `null` when not provided. Part of the customs declaration, so customers can still change it with a partial update after the delivery has left `announced`.

containerSizeAnnounced.description:
Size of the shipping container, as you announced it. Only for `container` deliveries; `null` otherwise.

- `20ft`: 20-foot container
- `40ft`: 40-foot container

isPalletizedAnnounced.description: Whether the goods in the shipping container are on pallets, as you announced it. Only for `container` deliveries; `null` otherwise.

deletedDate.description: When the delivery was cancelled (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` when it was not.

identifier.description: Short human-readable identifier of the delivery, shown in the dashboard and printed as a barcode on the delivery note.

statusUpdatedAt.description: When the status of the delivery last changed (ISO 8601, UTC).

inboundedDateTime.description: When the delivery was completed and its stock became available (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` until then.

inProcessingDateTime.description: When the warehouse started processing the delivery, moving it to `inProcessing` (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` until then.

atWarehouseDateTime.description: When the warehouse accepted the delivery, moving it to `atWarehouse` (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` until then.

aggregatedContainerStatus.description:
Tracking status of the delivery as a whole, combined from the tracking statuses of its containers; `null` when none of them is tracked.

- `pick_up`: waiting to be picked up by the carrier
- `in_transit`: on the way to the warehouse
- `out_for_delivery`: out for delivery to the warehouse
- `partially_delivered`: some containers were delivered, others not yet
- `delivered`: all containers were delivered
- `delayed`: delivery is delayed
- `failed_delivery`: the carrier failed to deliver

customsMRNProvidedAt.description: When the customs MRN was first provided (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` while there is none. The inbound deadline of an international delivery is not counted before this.

subStatus.description:
Detail on the current status; `null` when there is none.

- `waitingOnMRN`: the delivery needs a customs MRN before the warehouse can inbound it; provide it in `customsMRN`

originConfirmedAt.description: When the warehouse last recorded where the goods came from (`warehouseOriginIsUK`) (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` when it has not.

deliveryContainers.description: Parcels or pallets the delivery arrives in, one per tracking number; at least one is required when announcing. A full update replaces them all.

warehouseID.description: ID of the warehouse receiving the delivery (UUID).

warehouse.description: Warehouse receiving the delivery: its ID and country code.

deliveryStandards.description: Results of the delivery standards the warehouse checked on arrival; empty until they are checked.

type.description:
Type of delivery. Defaults to `regular`.

- `container`: arriving in a shipping container; the expected dates must be equal, a business day, and at least 10 business days from now
- `regular`: every other delivery
- `unknown`: type not recorded

acceptanceFee.description: Fee charged for accepting the delivery at the warehouse; `null` when none was charged.

customsPaid.description: Customs charges the warehouse paid on your behalf when receiving the delivery; `null` when none were paid.

damages.description: Description of the overall damage the warehouse found on the delivery; `null` when none was recorded.

deliveryCostsPaid.description: Delivery costs the warehouse paid on your behalf when receiving the delivery; `null` when none were paid.

deliveryNotes.description: Other comments the warehouse recorded when accepting the delivery; `null` when there are none.

putawayFee.description: Fee charged for putting the stock of the delivery away into storage; `null` when none was charged.

status.description:
Current status of the delivery.

- `announced`: announced and not yet arrived
- `atWarehouse`: arrived and accepted by the warehouse
- `inProcessing`: being counted and put away
- `completed`: inbounded; the stock is available
- `deleted`: cancelled

userID.description: ID of the user the delivery belongs to (UUID).

deliveredBoxes.description: Number of loose boxes (parcels) the warehouse counted on arrival; `null` until the delivery has been counted.

deliveredPallets.description: Number of full pallets the warehouse counted on arrival; `null` until the delivery has been counted.

containerSizeConfirmed.description:
Size of the shipping container, as confirmed by the warehouse on arrival. Only for `container` deliveries; `null` otherwise.

- `20ft`: 20-foot container
- `40ft`: 40-foot container

isPalletizedConfirmed.description: Whether the goods in the shipping container are on pallets, as confirmed by the warehouse on arrival. Only for `container` deliveries; `null` otherwise.

palletizationMinutes.description: Time the warehouse spent putting the goods of the shipping container onto pallets, in minutes. Only for `container` deliveries; `null` otherwise.

meetsEUOrganicRequirements.description: Whether the delivery meets the EU organic requirements, as checked by the warehouse; `null` when it was not checked.

warehouseOriginIsUK.description: Whether the goods came from within the United Kingdom, as found by the warehouse on arrival. Only recorded for deliveries to a UK warehouse not declared international; `false` means an MRN is needed before inbounding. `null` when not recorded.

standardsCompliance.description:
How far the delivery met the delivery standards checked by the warehouse on arrival.

- `compliant`: all standards were met
- `partially_compliant`: some standards were met
- `non_compliant`: no standard was met
- `compliance_not_checked`: the standards were not checked yet

sortedBoxesCount.description: Number of boxes the warehouse had to sort while processing the delivery; `null` until recorded.

sortedItemsCount.description: Number of items the warehouse had to sort while processing the delivery; `null` until recorded.

deliveryItems.description: Products in the delivery and their announced amounts; at least one is required when announcing, and each product may appear only once. A full update replaces them all.

inboundingDeadline.description: Date by which the warehouse is due to inbound the delivery, and how that date was set. Calculated by byrd; ignored when sent.

value.description: Amount, as a string with two decimals separated by a dot.

taxFactor.description: Tax factor of the price, for example `1.19` for 19% VAT; `null` when not set.

value.description: Value encoded in the barcode, 1 to 48 characters; which characters are allowed depends on `barcodeType`.

barcodeType.description:
Symbology of the barcode; required when `value` is set.

- `ean_13`: EAN-13
- `code_128`: Code 128
- `gs1_128`: GS1-128
- `qr_code`: QR code

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary barcode of the product, mirrored in its `barcode` and `barcodeType` fields. At most one barcode can be primary. Defaults to `false`.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (ISO 8601).

sequenceNumber.description: Position of the container within the delivery, used to order the containers; 0 or greater.

type.description:
How the container arrives. Use the same type for all containers of a delivery.

- `parcel`: a parcel
- `pallet`: a pallet
- `euroPallet`: a EUR-pallet (Euro-pallet)

exchangeablePallet.description: Whether the delivery is on exchangeable EUR-pallets (Euro-pallets, EPAL), which the warehouse exchanges for empty ones with the carrier on arrival. Set it to `false` when the pallet type is unknown or different.

carrier.description: Carrier bringing the container to the warehouse. Use `unknown` for any carrier not listed and give its name in `unknownCarrierName`.

unknownCarrierName.description: Name of the carrier when `carrier` is `unknown`; an empty string or `null` otherwise.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number of the container with its carrier, used to track it on its way to the warehouse; `null` when there is none. Must not be a URL.

trackingURL.description: URL where the container can be tracked; `null` or empty when there is none.

arrived.description: Whether the container has arrived at the warehouse, as recorded by the warehouse.

status.description:
Tracking status of the container, updated from the carrier tracking of its `trackingNumber`; `null` until the first tracking update.

- `pick_up`: waiting to be picked up by the carrier
- `in_transit`: on the way to the warehouse
- `out_for_delivery`: out for delivery to the warehouse
- `delivered`: delivered to the warehouse
- `delayed`: delivery is delayed
- `failed_delivery`: the carrier failed to deliver

deliveredAt.description: When the carrier delivered the container to the warehouse, according to its tracking (ISO 8601, UTC); `null` until then.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (ISO 8601).

sequenceNumber.description: Position of the item within the delivery, used to order the items; 0 or greater.

amount.description: Number of units of the product announced in the delivery; at least 1.

amountArrivedDamaged.description: Number of units that arrived damaged, as counted by the warehouse; `null` until recorded.

amountArrivedFinished.description: Number of units that arrived intact, as counted by the warehouse; `null` until recorded.

boxcode.description: Your identifier of the box or boxes the product arrives in. Separate several box codes with commas.

hasExistingStorage.description: Whether the product already has a storage location in the warehouse receiving the delivery.

newSKU.description: Whether the product had no stock location in the warehouse when the delivery was announced, making it new to that warehouse.

receivedAmount.description: Number of units put away into stock from this item so far.

productID.description: ID of the product announced in this item (UUID). The product must be active and cannot be a bundle or an alias.

bsku.description: Unique SKU byrd generates for the product, unrelated to your `sku`.

sku.description: Your stock keeping unit (SKU) for the product, unique among your products. It must match the SKU your sales channel sends on order lines.

name.description: Name of the product; at least one character.

organic.description: Whether the product is organic and needs special storage and shipping conditions. Bundles cannot be organic. Defaults to `false`.

grs.description: Whether the product complies with the Global Recycled Standard (GRS) and needs specific storage conditions. Defaults to `false`.

productType.description:
Type of the product. Defaults to `product`; `bundle`, `supplementary` and `packaging_material` cannot be changed afterwards.

- `product`: a regular physical product
- `bundle`: a group of other products sold under one SKU, see `bundleIngredients`
- `prepacked_product`: a product shipped in its own packaging
- `packaging_material`: packaging material, such as boxes or fillers
- `branding`: branded material packed into shipments, not counted as a product item
- `supplementary`: a product only shipped together with another product
- `alias`: another SKU for an existing product, sharing its stock
- `marketing`: marketing material

lotsEnabled.description: Whether lots (batches) of the product are tracked when it is inbounded and shipped. Bundles cannot be lot tracked. Defaults to `false`.

barcode.description: Value of the primary barcode printed on the product, at most 48 characters; mirrors the primary entry of `barcodes`. `null` when the product has no barcode.

barcodes.description: All barcodes printed on the product, at most one of them primary. When you send both `barcode` and `barcodes`, `barcode` must match the primary entry.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (ISO 8601).

deliveryID.description: ID of the delivery the check belongs to (UUID).

label.description:
Standard the delivery was checked against.

- `ANNOUNCED_BEFORE_ARRIVAL`: the delivery was announced before it arrived
- `ARRIVED_WITH_BYRD_ID`: the parcels or pallets carried the delivery ID
- `ARRIVED_WITH_DELIVERY_NOTE`: the delivery arrived with its delivery note

isFulfilled.description: Whether the delivery met the standard.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed (ISO 8601).

date.description: Date by which the warehouse is due to inbound the delivery (ISO 8601 date); `null` when there is no deadline yet.

type.description:
How the deadline was set.

- `not-applicable`: there is no deadline yet
- `sla`: calculated from the warehouse's inbound service level, counted from the arrival of the delivery
- `special-arrangement`: a date specially agreed with byrd

countryCode.description: Country the warehouse is in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
